entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one refined original 2D wuxia anime character concept model sheet for the original series Ou de Jianghu. Horizontal 3:2 canvas, pale warm grey plain studio background. Restrained elegant art direction: crisp precise ink linework, sculpted cel shading, believable adult anatomy, detailed but animation-readable silk folds and metal/jade ornaments, no photorealism, no 3D, no wooden puppet face, no puppet strings, no chibi. Layout: left 40% a large 3/4 bust portrait, right 60% the SAME character in a complete head-to-toe neutral standing view, separated by generous negative space. The face and costume match exactly across both views. Soft neutral diffuse light and subtle grounded shadow, no action effects or environmental narrative. No typography, captions, logos, borders, symbols outside the costume, or watermark. Crown top, hands, shoes, and hems must not be cropped. One person shown twice, no extra characters. This is a candidate concept sheet, not a finished turn-around.  IMPORTANT: leave a 6-percent blank margin above the ENTIRE crown/hat/head in BOTH views. Keep the identity the same within this sheet, but this character must have a DISTINCT face from the supplied style reference. Use the reference ONLY for restrained fine 2D linework, shading, material rendering and presentation, never its face or white robe. Avoid any extra jewellery, accessory, scar or weapon not in the description. Subject: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, hair in a lopsided topknot with a cheap copper pin. Patched ochre and brown layered robe with mismatched embroidered trims, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, a wide straw hat pushed back on his head. Always half-crouched, always listening. Specific identity requirements: Count exactly THREE copper coins with square holes on the red belt string, not four or two; show the string clearly on the full figure. Straw hat is pushed back, not absent. Keep him short and wiry, visibly older than the elegant protagonists, shrewd but not grotesque.
